text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's a wrap! Let's take a 
short break!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes, good work. ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nn... *sigh*, my shoulders are so stiff. 
It really is totally different from 
regular photoshoots.
choice_data_list: Well, you are the academy's PR, after all.
Well, it is academy PR, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City was requested through her agency 
to do a photoshoot to promote Tracen 
Academy. As a school representative, I 
accompanied her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's true too, but it's more like the 
outfit feels unfamiliar to move in. I 
thought I understood the proper etiquette 
for wearing a kimono, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's not an actual kimono, right? That's 
why it's so tricky to handle—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
No... What should I do? It's really great, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, was it different from what 
you imagined?"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
No, no! It's perfect, but... I just wanted 
to see a version with a slightly different 
vibe too.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Right now, the graceful elegance of a 
kimono comes through, but I also feel it 
might be a bit too refined compared to the 
overall impression of the outfit...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Then should we try doing it with a 
more relaxed feel?"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
No, could you let me think for a bit? I 
want to come up with a more novel 
situation that really highlights your 
charm... Hmmm!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Then let's have Trainer help us 
out!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You understand City-chan's charm, and 
above all, don't you think you might come 
up with ideas that we would never have 
thought of?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, my Trainer is just an ordinary 
Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you meant by "that's 
precisely why"! Trainer!! Please lend me 
your strength~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
............ Trainer, think you can handle 
it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think they're looking to bring in some 
fresh air, so any spontaneous ideas would 
be great.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flustered by the sudden request, I try to 
picture a situation that would truly bring 
out Gold City's charm—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? An angel...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... ooooh!! As expected of you, 
Trainer, that's it! That is precisely her 
charm that transcends human 
comprehension...!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'll arrange a shooting location right 
away! If it's a celestial maiden—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-click-click-click!)

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this is it...! A mystique that melts 
into the light... So beautiful~!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
S-She really looks like a celestial 
maiden... So pretty...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.
choice_data_list:
You really nailed the atmosphere, didn't 
you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...'Sup. By the way... How can you say 
embarrassing stuff like 'heavenly maiden' 
with a straight face?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: How on earth do you see me—
choice_data_list:
It was good to take the fans' opinions 
into account.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remembered hearing one of Gold City's 
fans call her "angelic" after seeing a 
photo of her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Just that? And that makes her... a 
celestial maiden?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Quit screwing around!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splaaash!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Get soaked! All of you! Hey... don't 
run away!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, City's looking great... Maybe I'll 
snap an off-shot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flash...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? A youkai...?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
I never thought of that...! With an 
alluring vibe... yeah, I can picture it! 
Let's give it a shot!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A-Are you serious...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-click-click-click!)

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... It feels like I'm being 
drawn into her eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*... City-chan, I didn't know you 
could make a face like that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Hey... You picking a fight with me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A monster? Just what do you take me for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, genre-wise, I guess she's more of a 
villainess than a saint, but...
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Then, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Japanese-style concept would 
suit a fighter who moves forward even when 
bruised and battered...? When I pondered 
that, for some reason, the first thing 
that came to mind was a youkai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...That's way too big of a leap, and you 
suck at explaining it. It's not really 
cool, it just ended up looking sexy, 
didn't it?
choice_data_list: That bewitching look suited you too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, that wasn't what you wanted to 
see, was it?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait here. I'll go tell the photographer 
to let us do things freely next time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You wanna see me race, right? ...Try not 
to fall for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Gold City captivated the entire 
shooting crew this time with her combative 
gaze.
